body:
We’ve built a system for automatically figuring out which object is meant by a word by having a neural network decide if the word belongs to each of about 100 automatically-discovered “types” (non-exclusive categories).

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/discovering-types-for-entity-disambiguation).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
